brief:
Israel's military closed the West Bank village of Taybeh to nonresidents on Sunday, restricting access to all but residents in response to mounting violence by Israeli settlers across the territory, according to Al-Monitor. The order affects the predominantly Christian community, which has faced growing threats alongside other Palestinian areas.

Military officials said the closure aimed to curb what they described as escalating settler attacks on Palestinians in the West Bank. The measure represents one response to a pattern of violence that has intensified across Palestinian communities in recent months, with settlers conducting raids and confrontations in multiple locations throughout the territory.
